Price ko hilata kaun hai? 🧱

Market order maal uthata hai, wo jaldi wala hai. Limit order maal rakhta hai, wo intezaar wala hai. Price ko market orders hilate hain, aur limit orders unke raaste ki deewar bante hain. Order Flow isi ladaai ko dekhna hai.
